summary: Chat 6 Control Plane is implemented on its dedicated work branch. Deterministic candidate/control-plane contracts and tooling exist, bounded Work Entry anti-rediscovery hardening is in place, and no surface candidate shard or product visual was authored. Completion is currently blocked by the PR workflow bot repeatedly materializing prisma-html/FILES_MANIFEST.json on the work branch, a global integration output outside Chat 6 write ownership.

blockers.detail: PRISMA GVAE All-Surface Authority auto-commits a fresh global FILES_MANIFEST.json to the Chat 6 work branch while PR #541 is open. Chat 6 is not authorized to retain that global integration output in its lane diff.

findings: Factory Ledger capability visual.generic_application_engine_v1 is DONE/SOURCE_READY with doNotRebuild=true, so Chat 6 advanced it without rebuilding GVAE.
The existing Visual Control census and Target Index are current physical truth for the promotion cohort; DISCOVERY_ONLY is not UNDISCOVERED.
Atlasfin structured registries are sufficient as the priority visual reference for Control Plane validation. Materiality Catalog was not inspected and remains STANDBY_USER_INVOKED_ONLY.
The all-surface authority workflow can mutate FILES_MANIFEST.json on the lane branch even when the lane itself never writes that path.
decisions: Preserve exactly the four Work Entry decisions: GVAE_EXACT_APPLY, SURFACE_BATCH_PLAN, REGISTER_TARGET_FIRST, BLOCKED.
Use REUSE_EXISTING_CENSUS_SEMANTIC_PROMOTION_REQUIRED for current census promotion and BROAD_REDISCOVERY_FORBIDDEN_CURRENT_CENSUS for forbidden recensus attempts.
Keep the canonical composer proposal-only: no canonical ID assignment and no direct registry/product mutation.
Treat the workflow-authored FILES_MANIFEST.json change as out-of-scope contamination to remove before handoff, not as lane output.
changedPaths: prisma-html/FILES_MANIFEST.json [workflow-bot write; out-of-scope blocker, must not remain in final lane diff]
